title: CBIC Clarifies Acceptance of New Zealand Electronic Certificates of Origin Under FTA
content:
# CBIC Clarifies Acceptance of New Zealand Electronic Certificates of Origin Under FTA

Ek important update hai. Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC) ne India aur New Zealand ke Free Trade Agreement (FTA) ke under New Zealand se aane wale electronic Certificates of Origin (e-CoO) ki acceptance ko clarify kiya hai. India-New Zealand FTA 20 October 2026 se effective ho gaya hai.

**Key Clarifications:**

*   **e-CoO Validity:** New Zealand ke issuing bodies dwara issue kiye gaye electronic Certificates of Origin (e-CoO) preferential tariff treatment claim karne ke liye valid honge.
*   **Conditions for Acceptance:** E-CoO tabhi valid mana jayega jab woh prescribed format mein ho, uspar issuing body ki seal aur authorised signatory ke signature hon, aur baki sabhi prescribed requirements satisfy karta ho.
*   **Authenticity Check:** Authenticity check karne ke liye previously circulated specimen seals aur signatures use kiye jayenge. Additionally, e-CoO par diye gaye QR code ya URL se bhi integrity verify ki ja sakti hai. Kisi bhi doubt ke case mein, verification ke liye Directorate of International Customs ke FTA Cell ko refer karna hoga.
*   **e-Sanchit Upload:** Importers aur Customs Brokers ko e-CoO ko e-Sanchit par upload karna hoga aur Bill of Entry mein uska certification number, date, aur originating criteria accurately enter karna hoga. ICES mein ek check bhi introduce kiya jayega jisse same e-CoO certification number ek se zyada Bill of Entry mein use na ho.
*   **Goods in Transit/Storage:** Jo New Zealand goods Agreement ke entry into force date (20 October 2026) par India transport ho rahe the ya customs control mein the (bonded warehouses mein bhi), unke liye Rule 25 (post-importation procedure) read with Rule 30 ke under preferential treatment claim kiya ja sakta hai.
*   **Official Reference:** Ye clarifications CBIC Instruction No. 21/2026-Customs dated 19 October 2026 mein di gayi hain. Is Instruction mein Notification No. 82/2026-Customs (N.T.) dated 12 October 2026 ka bhi reference hai, jo India-New Zealand FTA ke under Rules of Origin specify karta hai.
